fields.about:
Before my journey into software development, I was a full-time musician. I spent some time self-studying HTML and CSS and discovered I really enjoyed coding. Eventually I realized it was time to make the jump into tech professionally.

Problem solving and creative thinking skills from music, and the joy of figuring things out made the switch natural. Whether I'm debugging code or building something from scratch, I approach it the same way I approached music: with patience, attention to detail, and a joy for solving problems.

fields.title: Bite by Bite Reviews
fields.description:
Restaurant Review Application – Full-stack
platform for discovering and reviewing local
restaurants. Features complete CRUD
operations, built with Next.js, TypeScript,
Tailwind CSS, and Django/Python backend.
Includes TanStack Query for data fetching
and state management.
